verdict.rationale: The Codex CLI lives in a public GitHub repo (github.com/openai/codex), and a community comment implies the CLI's issues can be diagnosed/filed because it's open (codex-comm-9), while the same comment explicitly notes the Codex App is NOT open source. No evidence pack item states an actual license (e.g., MIT/Apache) for the CLI, so 'open license' status is inferred rather than confirmed, and other product surfaces (Codex App, cloud service) are explicitly closed. Missing for 10: an explicit license file/declaration for the CLI repo, and confirmation of open licensing for other Codex components (App, cloud environments).
